description: Defines the ProcessState class for managing kernel binder process state in Android, including thread pool management, driver configuration, and reference counting.

classes.name: ProcessState
classes.description: Manages the process-wide state for Android's binder IPC mechanism, including thread pool, driver configuration, and reference counting.

methods.name: self
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ProcessState.

methods.name: selfOrNull
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance or null if not initialized.

methods.name: initWithDriver
methods.description: Initializes ProcessState with a specific binder driver.

methods.name: getContextObject
methods.description: Retrieves the context object for a caller.

methods.name: becomeContextManager
methods.description: Promotes the process to be a context manager.

methods.name: getStrongProxyForHandle
methods.description: Gets a strong proxy for a given handle.

methods.name: expungeHandle
methods.description: Removes a handle from the process state.

methods.name: spawnPooledThread
methods.description: Spawns a thread in the thread pool.

methods.name: setThreadPoolMaxThreadCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of threads in the thread pool.

methods.name: enableOnewaySpamDetection
methods.description: Enables or disables spam detection for oneway calls.

methods.name: giveThreadPoolName
methods.description: Sets the thread name to indicate thread pool participation.

methods.name: getDriverName
methods.description: Returns the name of the binder driver.

methods.name: getStrongRefCountForNode
methods.description: Returns the strong reference count for a node.
